ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 8thday of June, 2026, by and between GEOMAR REALTY INC., a New York corporation having an address at c/o Michael Musialowski. 74 Torres Road, Rancho De Taos, New Mexico 87557 ("Owner"), and 74 TEN EYCK NY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 199 Lee Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11211 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter individually referred to as a “Party” and collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WHEREAS,Developer desires to construct the Developer Building on the Developer Parcel with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Parcel under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Parcel was considered to be a separate and independent zoning lot;
